", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0101", "tag": "p", "text": "“And you will follow after as soon as you can?” Francis asked the Latin American. “Regan, take hold of his little law affair yourself and expedite it, won’t you?”", "sha256": "ebdf7cf64b11e3ab0cd5152380a5cc01d1b87e026f8f355132f5f1aad49ed7a8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[118]", "source_html": "
